prompts: Pixel Arena, our Unreal game in {WS}, runs fine in the editor. In the packaged build, players say the arena has no colors, and the game crashes after a minute or so of play. The log of one packaged run is in {WS}/Saved/Logs. There is no engine on this machine, so you cannot build or run it. Find out why and fix the sources and the config. Record the causes in {WS}/result.json: crash_cause, no_colors_cause.
answers:
[goal] Root-cause packaged build issues in Pixel Arena; fix sources/config; record in result.json.
[action] Edited `Source/PixelArena/ArenaGameMode.h` (ScoreTracker now a `UPROPERTY() TObjectPtr`), `Config/DefaultGame.ini` (added `/Game/Data/Palettes` to `+DirectoriesToAlwaysCook`), wrote `result.json`.
[result] No engine on this machine, so no build/run; evidence is the shipping log plus the source. Crash: `UArenaScoreTracker* ScoreTracker` was a raw pointer, not a UPROPERTY, so GC collected it (`Collecting garbage: 412 objects purged` at 21.05.13), and `OnGoalScored` dereferenced it in `AddPoints` (EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION at 0xffffffffffffffff). No colors: shipping cook excluded `/Game/Data/Palettes` (bCookAll=False; only Arena map and Effects dir cooked), so `DA_Primary` failed to load (`Couldn't find file for package /Game/Data/Palettes/DA_Primary`) and the fallback gray was used.
[next] In an engine-equipped machine, re-package and confirm: palette loads (no "Palette is null" warning) and goal scoring no longer crashes. Assumption: `UArenaScoreTracker` is a UObject like the other NewObject'd classes; Stats is a plain struct freed in EndPlay, which is fine.
